input.quote:
18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 18 is a complete insurance clause meeting every preferred element: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, so the Customer Data condition is satisfied for this hosting vendor). Section 18.2 requires certificates of insurance on request and adds Customer-favourable extras (primary coverage, advance notice of cancellation, insurance not limiting Vendor's liabilities). No redline is warranted; this sits at our preferred position.
